semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: Conformal prediction is a statistical technique that can be used within the broader domain of predictive modeling, as it provides a way to quantify the uncertainty in the predictions made by any model.

parent_domains.justification: Conformal prediction is a framework within predictive modeling that allows users to calculate confidence measures for the predictions made by machine learning models.
